queries.name: GCP: All users
queries.description: List all GCP_User nodes.

queries.name: GCP: All groups
queries.description: List all GCP_Group nodes.

queries.name: GCP: Group memberships
queries.description: Show users (and other principals) that are members of GCP groups via GCP_MemberOf.

queries.name: GCP: Members of each group
queries.description: Group membership edges (BloodHound Explore shows paths; open the table pane for columns).

queries.name: GCP: Groups each user belongs to
queries.description: Inverse membership view: user → groups.

queries.name: GCP: Principals with org-level roles
queries.description: Principals that have role edges onto organizations.

queries.name: GCP: Principals with folder-level roles
queries.description: Principals that have role edges onto folders.

queries.name: GCP: Group membership into IAM grants
queries.description: Paths from users through group membership into any IAM/role edge on a resource.
queries.query: MATCH p = (u:GCP_User)-[:GCP_MemberOf]->(g:GCP_Group)-[r]->(t) WHERE type(r) <> 'GCP_MemberOf' RETURN p

queries.name: GCP: Who can create SA keys
queries.description: Principals with GCP_CanCreateKeys onto service accounts.

queries.name: GCP: Who can impersonate SAs
queries.description: Principals with impersonation / token edges onto service accounts.

queries.name: GCP: Workload Identity federation
queries.description: Workload identity pools and providers per project (federation = external identity to SA impersonation surface).

queries.name: GCP: Direct service access (SQL, Functions, Pub/Sub)
queries.description: Access edges from the signed-in user to Cloud SQL, Cloud Functions and Pub/Sub resources discovered by the collectors.

queries.name: GCP: Functions running as service accounts
queries.description: Cloud Functions and the service accounts they run as — code execution in a function yields the SA's identity.

queries.name: GCP: Bucket policy grants (resource-level)
queries.description: Principals with policy-control grants on individual storage buckets (resource-level IAM, CAI-based).

queries.name: GCP: Direct secret access grants (resource-level)
queries.description: Principals granted access on individual secrets (resource-level IAM, CAI-based) — distinct from project-wide access.

queries.name: GCP: Pub/Sub topology
queries.description: Topics, subscriptions and their SubscribesTo relationships.

queries.name: GCP: Roles by permission count
queries.description: IAM roles referenced in collected bindings with their expanded permission lists (custom roles show real permissions).
queries.query: MATCH (r:GCP_Role) RETURN r ORDER BY r.permissionCount DESC

queries.name: GCP: Open ingress firewall rules
queries.description: Firewall rules flagged HIGH risk (0.0.0.0/0 ingress, not disabled).

queries.name: GCP: KMS keys
queries.description: Cloud KMS crypto keys with purpose and rotation metadata.
queries.query: MATCH (k:GCP_KMSKey) RETURN k ORDER BY k.keyring

queries.name: GCP: Cloud Run service invokers
queries.description: Principals who can invoke Cloud Run services (code execution as the service's runtime service account).
